name: Glade Parks
summary: Glade Parks is a 194-acre lifestyle center in Euless featuring big-box retailers, diverse restaurants, a movie theater, and arcade entertainment. This highly-rated destination serves the Dallas-Fort Worth mid-cities area with convenient shopping and family-friendly attractions.
demographics: Glade Parks attracts a diverse mix of families and young professionals from the mid-cities area of the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, with a median household income ranging from $60,000 to $85,000. The primary trade area draws from Euless, Bedford, and Hurst, serving households with children who value convenient access to entertainment and dining options. Visitors typically range from 25-54 years old, with a strong presence of dual-income families seeking one-stop shopping for retail, dining, and entertainment needs.
description: Glade Parks is a premier 194-acre lifestyle destination in Euless, Texas, strategically positioned in the heart of the Dallas-Fort Worth mid-cities corridor. This expansive open-air center has established itself as a go-to destination for families and entertainment seekers, featuring a compelling mix of big-box retailers, diverse dining options, a state-of-the-art movie theater, and an engaging arcade. The center's thoughtful layout across nearly 200 acres provides ample parking and easy navigation between its various attractions, making it a convenient choice for both quick shopping trips and extended family outings. With operating hours from 9 AM to 10 PM daily, Glade Parks accommodates busy schedules while maintaining its reputation as a community gathering place. The center's strong 4.5-star rating from nearly 3,000 reviews reflects its consistent ability to deliver quality experiences across its retail, dining, and entertainment offerings.
